name: Blackrock clan
summary: In Blackrock Mountain, veterans of the Blackrock clan now stand divided between Thrall's New Horde and the Dark Horde. Strict ranks, heavy armor, and skill at the forge once made the clan a force in the First and Second Wars.

sections.title: The Anvil of the Old Horde
sections.body:
From Draenor came the Blackrock orcs, whose strength lay in strict ranks, heavy armor, and skill at the forge. Under Chieftain Blackhand, they formed the brutal core of the Old Horde's invasion of Azeroth and laid siege to Stormwind.

Orgrim Doomhammer killed Blackhand to free the Horde from Gul'dan's direct control. Blackrock leaders then commanded both the clan and the Horde through the hard campaigns of the Second War.

sections.title: A Fractured Legacy
sections.body:
After the Horde's defeat at Blackrock Mountain, the clan broke apart. Many warriors went to Alliance internment camps, then Thrall freed them and welcomed them into his reformed New Horde.

Others would not yield. They gathered behind Blackhand's sons, Rend and Maim, and withdrew to the heights of Blackrock Spire. There they formed the hostile Dark Horde with remnants of the Dragonmaw and other rogue clans.

sections.title: The Threat in the Spire
sections.body:
From his throne in Blackrock Spire, Rend Blackhand claims the title of true Warchief. The Dark Horde keeps a tense truce with the Dark Iron dwarves in the molten depths below, even as it fights both the Alliance and Thrall's Horde.

Clan remnants tainted by demons have also been seen in Lordaeron. There they seek to revive dark sacrificial rites.

faq.q: Are the Blackrock orcs part of Thrall's Horde?
faq.answer: Some Blackrock orcs serve Thrall, but most found in the Eastern Kingdoms do not. Veteran Eitrigg and others serve Thrall in Kalimdor. At Blackrock Mountain, most follow Rend Blackhand and regard Thrall's New Horde as weak traitors.

faq.q: Who is currently leading the Blackrock clan?
faq.answer: Rend Blackhand leads the Dark Horde splinter faction in Blackrock Mountain and claims command of the clan his father led. Blackrock orcs who joined the New Horde answer to Warchief Thrall.

The Dark Horde is a rogue force in Upper Blackrock Spire, made up of unrepentant Blackrock orcs, Black Tooth Grin veterans, and allied Dragonmaw orcs. Led by Rend Blackhand, they reject Thrall's authority and seek to conquer Azeroth under the Old Horde's banner.

Orgrim Doomhammer killed Warchief Blackhand during the First War to strip the Shadow Council of its puppet ruler. In a mak'gora duel, Orgrim crushed Blackhand's skull with the Doomhammer, then took the titles of Warchief and Blackrock clan leader.

faq.q: Why are there Blackrock orcs in Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Some Blackrock warbands fled north or hid in Lordaeron after the Second War. Some returned to demon worship and dark sacrifices, drawing the ire of the Alliance and, during the Third War, the Scourge.

angles.text: As an orc, you know the Blackrocks gave the Horde two of its greatest Warchiefs. Their surviving remnants in the Eastern Kingdoms recall the Old Horde's bloodshed.
As a blacksmith, you can trace orcish siegecraft and heavy plate armor to the Blackrock clan's famed metalworking. They forged for centuries in elemental-powered furnaces using unique ores.
As an Alliance fighter, you have faced the Blackrock clan in three wars, from Stormwind's burning to the bloody sieges of Blackrock Mountain and Khaz Modan.
As a Horde loyalist, you know Thrall sees Rend's Blackrock extremists as a grave threat to the New Horde's peace and honor. He calls them renegades who cling to demonic servitude.
